content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with in-house title and mortgage services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Homebuilder selling detached and attached homes to individual buyers with captive mortgage financing, though it also has rental and lot-sale lines."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time buyers, with in-house mortgage and title services for the same buyers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Develops raw land into lots sold B2B to homebuilders; it does not build or sell homes to individual buyers."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with captive mortgage financing and some lot sales."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells detached and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with mortgage and title subsidiaries."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Insurance underwriter selling title, mortgage guaranty and commercial policies; it does not build or sell homes."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells life insurance, cemetery and mortuary services alongside mortgages; homebuilding is absent from its business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Title insurer and software and data provider; it does not build or sell residential homes to buyers."}]}
